text: Build job 1 of the records-history plan (docs/design/records-history.md section 10, decision D111): the schema and the writer. Add the new record types (landing-intent, landing, intervention, checkpoint, legacy-exempt, import-manifest) to athena-data with their schemas and validation, and a writer that commits records to the branch athena/records (its own root, never merged into main) with compare-and-swap and bounded retry as section 8.2 describes. Tests: two simultaneous writers both land; a rejected update retries and then succeeds; a writer never rewrites or deletes an existing record path. Also add a read-only check that reports whether the host forbids force-pushes and deletion on athena/records and requires branches to be up to date before merging on main; it reports, it changes no host setting. Nothing reads or writes the new branch in the job pipeline yet; records/ on main and the history check are unchanged.
